title: About | Saltay Hanalei Bay
description: Meet the people and philosophy behind Saltay Botanical Spa: botanical wisdom, personalized care, and a deeper connection to yourself and Kaua‘i.
heading: Who we are
introduction: At Saltay Botanical Spa, we bring together the wisdom of plants, therapeutic bodywork, and time-honored healing traditions to create a more holistic approach to wellness. Founded by Master Herbalist and Licensed Acupuncturist Wanda Sakari, Saltay is a space to reconnect with yourself, deepen your relationship with the natural world, and embrace a more vibrant, authentic way of living.
hero_image_alt: Wanda standing by the ocean with a turquoise scarf outstretched in the breeze
mission_heading:
More than a treatment.
A way of being.
mission_text: Saltay brings herbal arts and therapeutic bodywork together in full-body experiences inspired by Battlefield Botanical Medicine. Our purpose is to share both care and knowledge, encouraging you to take an active part in your wellbeing.
philosophy_text: We see wellbeing as a relationship: with yourself, your community, and the land and sea around you. Custom botanical formulations and thoughtful touch invite you to slow down, reconnect, and find your own sense of balance.
mantra:
A slower rhythm.
A deeper connection.
founder_heading:
A practice with heart.
A purpose beyond the spa.
founder_text: Wanda founded Saltay to help people feel more connected to their health and wellbeing. Her training with martial artist and Chinese medical practitioner Tom Bisio informs a practice that brings botanical traditions into a deeply personal spa experience.
founder_detail: That spirit extends beyond Kaua‘i. Wanda has shared botanical medicine practices with underserved communities around the world, teaching skills that encourage confidence, connection, and self-care.
team_introduction: Get to know a few of the people who bring Saltay’s philosophy to life.
booking_heading: Make a little space for yourself.
booking_text: Explore the rituals, find what speaks to you, and let your Saltay experience begin.

practitioners.name: Wanda Sakari
practitioners.description: Master Herbalist, Licensed Acupuncturist, and owner. Wanda brings botanical medicine to spa rituals, remote sessions, apprenticeships, and personal retreats.

practitioners.name: Angela Walker
practitioners.description: A Kaua‘i-based licensed esthetician with 25 years in health, beauty, and wellness. Angela’s approach cares for the skin from the inside out.

practitioners.name: Opinder
practitioners.description: With decades of personal practice, Opinder brings an intuitive presence to meditation, somatic healing, and energy work, creating space for reflection and reconnection.

practitioners.name: Krish
practitioners.description: Krish has a deep sense of connection to the elements and enjoys delivering Biodynamic lymphfascial unwinding with energy balancing for a profound deep level of healing - a master in many disciplines, Krish’s style of bodywork often encourages Saltay Guests to book multiple sessions before it’s time for their departure back home.
